decisions.5V_controller_supply: Requires4.5V logic-level pass FET; PSMN2R4-30YLD remains comparison candidate.
decisions.battery_controller_supply: Not adopted as a shortcut: VCC-OUT drives fault timer and ENOUT comparison; separate-supply behavior, battery cutoff and rail sequencing require redesign.

limits: Normal loss extends the25A RDSon test value to lower current; temperature rise changes resistance.
Fixed mounting base125C is a comparison, not measured board temperature.
Continuous thermal failure does not reject short pulse use; pulse SOA must be evaluated separately.
10nF minimum is not a selected fault time; timer current depends on state and inferred VDS.
Do not raise battery cutoff solely to obtain gate drive without checking usable energy and battery specifications.
